name: Wraps of Unarmed Power, +1

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: +1 to attack and damage rolls with Unarmed Strikes.
text: While you're wearing these wraps, you have a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with Unarmed Strikes, and your Unarmed Strikes count as magical.
